newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Dec wage inflation 4.1 pct -Istat.
newsitem.headline: Italian Dec wage inflation 4.1 pct -Istat.

text.p: Italian wage inflation stood at an annual 4.1 percent in December, statistics institute ISTAT said in a statement.
ITALY HOURLY WAGE INFLATION Dec 96 Nov 96

Istat said wage inflation in the agriculture sector grew 1.0 percent year-on-year in December, 3.2 percent in the industrial sector, 6.0 percent in the chemical sector, 2.6 percent in the metalworkers sector, 3.5 percent in the service sector, 1.5 percent in the transport and communications sector and 6.1 percent in the public administration.
The statistics office added that the number of hours lost to industrial action in the Jan-Nov period of 1996 was a provisional 7,931,000 hours from 6,023,000 in Jan-Nov 1995.
